svg.title: One droplet, two reported sizes: Simulating the Pallas cloud probes
svg.desc: At a common simulated wavelength of 633 nm, a droplet 11.97 µm across is sized at 12.55 µm on average by FSSP and 13.42 µm by ICEMET, on opposite sides of the 13 µm cutoff.
